claims.claim: The repository preserves the Champion construction recipe: GBPUSD entry hour 11; USDJPY short and entry hour 11; AUDUSD minimum 6 bars and entry hour 11; then sequential portfolio aggregation.
The historical Champion headline equity/trade/drawdown figures cannot be reproduced from the governed repository alone.
apply_position_sizing.py scales completed net_return and then clips only the lower tail; this is not an executable stop-loss simulation.
The surviving exploratory sweep evaluates and ranks parameter combinations on the same supplied history; it does not itself establish independent out-of-sample performance.
monthly_walkforward evaluates later monthly slices but contains no per-fold training/selection step and uses an assumed intrabar path when TP and SL are both touched.
Independent repository code preserves MA20/MA50, vol12 with ddof=0 and threshold 0.0005, pair-specific UTC sessions, one-bar delay, minimum hold 3 bars and state-transition semantics.
Behavioural reproducibility does not establish historical or out-of-sample expected value under the RND-0025 execution-grade research contract.
